annotations.title: Create a task from a TODO

description: Create a task from a TODO comment in code, keeping the file path and line number (label todo-from-code plus any labels you pass; priority as in taskhold_create; use taskhold_create for anything else). Returns the new task with its id and code location. Fails at the account's task ceiling or on an invalid project name.

file_path.description: Path of the file containing the TODO

priority.description: Priority (default medium; low unless it's a real bug)

project.description: Project name, e.g. the repo folder ("api-server"). Matched case-insensitively; created on first use. Use this instead of project_id.

name: taskhold_create_from_todo
title: Create a task from a TODO
